Senior Full Stack Developer

About Comply - Compliance teams are asked to do more with less. Comply helps meet these growing demands and ensure compliance in a complex and ever-changing environment. For more, visit our website - https://www.thecomply.ai/?utm_source=form&utm_campaign=fullstackdev

Role - Senior Full Stack Engineer

Experience - 1-5 Years

Location - Remote India

Positions - 2

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team. You’ll have the opportunity to work across the full technology stack, contribute to real-world projects, and learn from experienced engineers.

Responsibilities


 * Work on both frontend and backend development.
 * Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
 * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
 * Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement.
 * Learn and adapt to new technologies as needed.
 * Ofcourse, everything revolves around AI!
   
   

Requirements


 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (BCA, MCA), Engineering (BE, BTech), or related field.
 * Strong foundation in programming languages (JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar).
 * Basic knowledge of web frameworks (React, Node.js, Django, etc.).
 * Familiarity with databases (SQL, NoSQL).
 * Eagerness to learn, problem-solving mindset, and strong communication skills.
